landing.heading: Turn your event idea into an actionable plan
landing.description: EventFlow proposes an editable checklist and budget, helps you discover approved vendors and request structured quotes. Every AI suggestion stays pending your review — nothing is applied until you approve it.
landing.featuresDescription: These are the capabilities available in EventFlow. Nothing more, nothing less.

plan.title: Suggested starting plan
plan.description: Describe your event and get a proposed set of phases and tasks as an editable starting point.

checklist.title: Editable checklist
checklist.description: Generate a task list with relative due dates and adjust it before applying it to your event.

budget.title: Suggested budget
budget.description: Get a proposed breakdown of line items and edit it in your event's currency.

vendors.title: Vendor directory
vendors.description: Search and filter approved vendors by category and city.

quotes.title: Structured quotes
quotes.description: Send requests with a consistent brief and compare the responses side by side.

hitl.title: You stay in control
hitl.description: Every AI suggestion is shown as a proposal: accept it, edit it or discard it.

metadata.title: EventFlow — Turn your event idea into an actionable plan
metadata.description: Plan weddings, quinceañeras, christenings, baby showers, birthdays and small corporate events with AI assistance: editable checklist and budget, approved vendors and comparable quotes. Every suggestion waits for your approval.

controls.birthday: Show birthday or baby shower suggestion

wedding.title: Budget optimisation
wedding.description: We spot opportunities to cut costs without affecting the experience or the quality of your event.
wedding.imageAlt: Elegant wedding reception with guests and floral decoration.

celebration.title: Ideas that fit you
celebration.description: Get suggestions for decor, services and experiences based on your style, budget and guest count.
celebration.imageAlt: Social celebration with guests, careful decoration and warm lighting.

baptism.title: Move forward step by step
baptism.description: EventFlow builds a task plan tailored to your event so you always know what to do and when.
baptism.imageAlt: Christening celebration with delicate decoration and a family atmosphere.

birthday.title: Everything under control
birthday.description: Organise every detail, vendor and key date in one place, without losing track of anything.
birthday.imageAlt: Birthday or baby shower celebration with elegant decor and a warm atmosphere.

corporate.title: Better coordinated vendors
corporate.description: Compare proposals, track deliverables and keep all your vendor information organised in one space.
corporate.imageAlt: Premium corporate event with attendees in an elegant venue.

howItWorks.heading: From idea to plan in three steps
howItWorks.description: EventFlow does not organise the event for you: it gives you an ordered starting point and you decide what to keep.

define.title: Describe your event
define.description: Event type, date, guest count, city and estimated budget. That is enough to get started.

propose.title: AI proposes a plan
propose.description: You get phases and tasks with relative dates, a budget breakdown and the vendor categories usually needed.

decide.title: You decide what gets applied
decide.description: Every suggestion is shown as a proposal: accept it, edit it or discard it. Nothing reaches your event without your approval.

forVendors.heading: Receive quote requests with the full picture
forVendors.description: If you provide event services, EventFlow brings you organizers who already know what they need.
forVendors.listLabel: What you can do as a vendor

profile.title: Your profile and packages
profile.description: Publish your approved profile, your services and your portfolio so organizers can find you in the directory.

quotes.title: Structured requests
quotes.description: Every request arrives with the event brief, so you reply with a comparable quote without back and forth.

reviews.title: Moderated reviews
reviews.description: Reviews left by organizers go through moderation before they appear on your profile.

finalCta.heading: Start planning with more clarity
finalCta.description: Create your event, review what AI proposes and keep only what makes sense for you.
